caption: The video captures a wooden articulated hand model palm-up on a wooden board, with a two-tone lollipop resting diagonally across its palm. The upper half is a speckled green disc, the lower half a glossy red mass, joined by a brown syrupy waist that leaves a wet stain on the palm. A yellow and a red gumball sit at the left edge, a pink macaron at the right, and a striped cloth at the upper corner. Throughout the excerpt the red portion slowly softens and slumps, its glossy surface spreading and its lower edge drooping downward. The green half, the stick with its purple-and-yellow wrapper, the hand, and surrounding candies appear unchanged under a fixed camera view, the melting already underway when the clip opens and continuing as it ends.
